<a name="RouteServiceClient"></a>
## type RouteServiceClient

RouteServiceClient is the client API for RouteService service.

For semantics around ctx use and closing/ending streaming RPCs, please refer to https://pkg.go.dev/google.golang.org/grpc/?tab=doc#ClientConn.NewStream.

```go
type RouteServiceClient interface {
    // Declare a new Route intent.
    // Controller materializes the runtime resource on reconciliation.
    CreateRoute(ctx context.Context, in *CreateRouteRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*CreateRouteResponse, error)
    // Fetch a Route CR by name.
    GetRoute(ctx context.Context, in *GetRouteRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*GetRouteResponse, error)
    // Full replace of a Route spec.
    UpdateRoute(ctx context.Context, in *UpdateRouteRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*UpdateRouteResponse, error)
    // Partial update via JSON merge patch RFC 7396.
    PatchRoute(ctx context.Context, in *PatchRouteRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*PatchRouteResponse, error)
    // List Route CRs with optional phase/runtime/host filter and paging.
    ListRoutes(ctx context.Context, in *ListRoutesRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*ListRoutesResponse, error)
    // Delete a Route CR and its materialized runtime resources.
    DeleteRoute(ctx context.Context, in *DeleteRouteRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*DeleteRouteResponse, error)
    // Stream phase transitions for a Route CR.
    // Streams indefinitely — routes have no terminal phase; close client-side.
    WatchRoute(ctx context.Context, in *WatchRouteRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (grpc.ServerStreamingClient[WatchRouteResponse], error)
}
```
